profile.headline: Senior-Level .NET Developer
profile.summary:
Over twenty years of experience, including expertise in C# SQL, various web technologies, and development on large-scale, n-tier web applications.

Specialties: C#, .NET Core, SQL, HTML, Javascript, jQuery

positions.title: Senior Development Consultant
positions.description:
Served as a senior developer, team lead (mentor), and chairman of the employee engagement committee.
Projects:
MedCentris
•	Worked with a team to develop a wound management web application. Technologies: C#, Angular, and Typescript with a SQL Server backend.

Coachwell, Inc.
•	Worked with a team to develop a personal coaching web application. Technologies: C#, Angular, and Typescript with a SQL Server backend.

Oilfield Instrumentation
•	Worked on a suite of software tools used by rig personnel to monitor rig operations data and to detect alarm conditions on the rig. Technologies: C#, SQL Server, jQuery, VB.NET, Windows Forms

Blue Cross Blue Shield of Louisiana
•	Subscriber Migration Project: Wrote an application that queried for subscribers and migrated them to a new enrollment system.
•	Statement of Benefits Outsourcing Project: Wrote an application that examined and routed tens of thousands of statement of benefits documents to various network drives.
•	Front End Edits Project: Worked on software that checks the validity of submitted medical claims based on subscriber input and business rules.
Technologies: C#, ASP.NET, SQL Server

Pike Enterprises
•	Developed a timesheet management system that tracked and managed hours and rates for crews, employees, and equipment. Technologies: C#, ASP.NET MVC, SQL Server, Knockout, Bootstrap

Functionally Integrated Training & Therapy, Inc. (FITT)
•	Developed a fitness evaluation web application. Technologies: C#, Entity Framework, SQL Server

Whitney Bank
•	Built a software proxy using C# .NET to enhance the security of the bank’s online banking system.

Louisiana Department of Transportation & Development (LaDOTD)
•	Developed for the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act (ARRA) website for the Louisiana Department of Transportation & Development (LaDOTD). Technologies: VB.NET, SQL Server

positions.title: Software Developer & Data Integrator
positions.description: • Developed C# .NET web applications for the Army Capabilities Integration Center (ARCIC).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Added features such as Common Access Card (CAC) authentication to the Shipyard Automated Budget Reporting System (SABRS) using C#, ASP.NET, and Oracle.
• Resolved issues and fixed bugs found in the system.
• Managed the configuration management process for SABRS, including building and deploying software builds for testing and release.

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Senior Programmer Analyst, NASA Langley Research Center, Hampton, VA
August 2004 – October 2008
•	Wrote Java (J2EE) and C# code using the Windchill API to enable a desktop application to connect to Windchill and drag-and-drop to and from a Windows file system.
•	Developed a web-based, 3-tier data management system for NASA element and campaign data using C#, ASP.NET, JavaScript, ASP.NET AJAX, and SQL Server.
Senior Programmer Analyst, NASA Headquarters, Washington, DC
•	Wrote Java (J2EE) classes and server pages and created workflow and lifecycle templates for user registration, profile management, and the Review Item Discrepancy (RID) process in NASA's Integrated Collaborative Environment (ICE), whose user base is 5,000+.
•	Built portal websites that used Java Server Pages and Java servlets to manage data stored in MySQL databases for NASA Capabilities Inventory (NCI) tool study.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed targeting desktop applications using Java (J2EE) and Sybase for use by the Department of Defense.
•	Developed a web-based information routing and alert system for CENTCOM using Java Server Pages, client-side Java applications, Java servlets, and Oracle.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Wrote utility applications in Perl.
•	Wrote C++ web server functions with the Netscape Server Application Programming Interface.
•	Provided technical support for several applications, including Netscape Enterprise Server, Collabra Server, Proxy Server, and Majordomo List Server.

certifications.name: Microsoft Certified Professional Developer (MCPD): Web Developer 4
certifications.title: Microsoft Certified Professional Developer (MCPD): Web Developer 4

certifications.name: Microsoft Certified Professional Developer (MCPD): ASP.NET Developer 3.5
certifications.title: Microsoft Certified Professional Developer (MCPD): ASP.NET Developer 3.5
